market_wrap.text: Nifty fell about 1.1% to roughly 25,607, with IT the weakest sector (Nifty IT -1.9%) and FMCG down about 0.9%, while metals rose (Nifty Metal +1.4%). In morning trade, HDFC Sky linked the weakness to proposed US tariffs of up to 20% on 14 trading partners including India and to expectations of a Fed rate hike in December; no full close report could be opened, so the closing figures are from the snapshot.

reasons.reason: Silver extended its rebound from near 14-month lows: MCX silver was up about 5–6% to around ₹1.53–1.54 lakh/kg in the afternoon and COMEX silver about 10% higher, on value buying, a recovery in Asian tech stocks and thin Thanksgiving trade.

Gold rebounded with silver: MCX December gold rose about 3% to roughly ₹1.26 lakh per 10g at the day's high, on value buying after recent lows; Upstox noted the December Fed meeting and sticky US inflation could cap gains.
